text:
Construction is underway on the $36 million renovation and expansion of the Eastern Parkway Library, a two-story Classical Revival Carnegie library at 1044 Eastern Parkway in Crown Heights, Brooklyn. Designed by Allied Works and managed by the New York City Department of Design and Construction for Brooklyn Public Library, the project will expand the 12,250-square-foot branch’s public space by more than 50 percent and add a 13,400-square-foot, three-story wing along Schenectady Avenue. The project will also include a renovated courtyard with outdoor seating, a third-floor reading terrace surrounded by greenery, and a permanent home for the branch’s Adult Learning Center.
Renderings show the original structure restored to its architectural integrity, with the five-bay limestone façade, arched entrance portal, and distinctive long arched windows retained and repaired. The new wing rises behind a large glass façade and contains a double-height reading room filled with natural light, overlooked by a reading mezzanine. The interior palette consists of untreated Belgian oak, coal terrazzo, perforated metal ceilings, and precast concrete. A new ramped entrance, elevator, and restrooms will make the building fully ADA-compliant, while a green roof, high-performance glazing, and upgraded HVAC, plumbing, and fire alarm systems are expected to bring the building to LEED Silver certification.
Reconfigured interiors will contain a main reading room, a teen zone, two children’s zones, a STEAM room, a multipurpose room with a projector, a community room, and a classroom in the restored fireplace room. Through the Department of Cultural Affairs’ Percent for Art program, Brooklyn-based artist Oasa DuVerney will install a series of reflective portraits of writers from the African diaspora on the reading mezzanine.
The branch is closed for the duration of construction. A temporary pop-up library will open in the neighborhood this fall, with space provided by Settlement Housing Fund, furnishings donated by IKEA, and additional support from Amazon.
